·Aman has three children i.e. 2 male and 1 female.

·Priya is married to Deepak who has three children.

·Ashu is the husband of Ashita, who has three children.

·Ashu and Deepak are the brothers of Anchal.

·Vishal is the only son of Priya.

So, Vishal is the grandson of Aman.

questions.q_en: If 29 January 2003 is a Wednesday, then what day of the week will be 26 February 2005?
questions.solution_en:
It is given that,

29 January 2003 is a Wednesday.

26 February 2005 is the 759th day after 29 January 2003.

Each day of the week is repeated after 7 days.

Hence, on the 759th day (108 weeks and 3 days) it will be a Saturday.

Seven flags P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are in a ground at a certain direction from each other. The flag P is in which direction with respect to flag S ?

Statement I: Flag V is to the north of Q, which is to the west of R. Flag T is to the north of S. Flag P is exactly between U and V.

Statement II: Flag U is to the west of V. Flag R is exactly between T and S. T is to the east of V.
options_en: If the data in statement I alone are sufficient to answer the question, while the data in statement II alone are not sufficient to answer the question
If the data in statement II alone are sufficient to answer the question, while the data in statement I alone are not sufficient to answer the question
If the data in both statements I and II together are necessary to answer the question
If the data given in both statements I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question
questions.solution_en:
It is given that,

Seven flags P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are in a ground at a certain direction from each other.

Statement I,

Flag V is to the north of Q, which is to the west of R. Flag T is to the north of S. Flag P is exactly between U and V.

Here, the position of P is not defined.

Hence, statement I alone is not sufficient.

Statement II,

Flag U is to the west of V. Flag R is exactly between T and S. T is to the east of V.

We do not have further information hence statement II alone is not sufficient.

From statements I and II,

Flag V is to the north of Q which is to the west of R. Flag T is to the north of S. Flag R is exactly between T and S. Flag U is to the west of V. Flag P is exactly between U and V.

T is to the east of V.

We get,

Here, flag P is to the north-west of flag S.

Hence, the data in both statements I and II together are necessary to answer the question.
